title: Stock Listed on Mobius Is Now Open for Bids
body_markdown:
## **What changes when you sell**


Turn on **Live for Bids** in a listing's **Selling Settings** , and the listing takes bids at any time, without waiting for an auction. We publicize it on our store and send it to partner distribution lists, with a reach of about 250,000 impressions a month.


Bids from the product page arrive in the same offers view as auction bids, and you handle them the same way. Your company name stays off the product page, which shows buyers only a general description such as US-Based Company.


Selling Settings puts all three distribution channels on one panel: **Live for Bids** , **In Auction** , and **On eCommerce** , with your target and reserve prices beside them. On the Inventory page, listings now sort into a tab for each channel.


Prices on excess components move between auctions. A listing open for bids lets an offer arrive when a buyer needs the part, and it gives you a real number to weigh against your target.


## **Bidding is live on Mobius product pages**


Find the part you need and place a bid from its product page.


[Shop parts on Mobius](https://app.mobiusmaterials.com/categories?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=open-for-bids-launch-2026)


If you hold excess inventory, our team can help you choose which channels fit each part.
